messages:
mira: quick heads-up — did an int8 onboard run for nova-v1 on the multilingual suite and flagged a few oddities for KR/JP and AR/HE locales.

sam: what oddities?

mira: short summary: KO/JA token merges around honorifics/ruby/furigana, and arabic/hebrew bracket orientation flips in shortctx translations. chrF dropped ~2.7 on ko/ja testset after quant.

jia: is this only after quant or also in fp16?

mira: fp16 baseline is fine — metrics: fp16 chrF(ko)=46.2, int8 chrF(ko)=43.5. BLEU hardly moved on en->ja but detok errors look systemic.

oleg: can you paste a failing example?

mira: sure. sample (original / model detok):

```
src (ko): "형님께서 오셨어요."
ref (en): "Big brother has arrived."
int8 output: "형 님께서오셨어요."
```

mira: notice the space inserted inside honorific token and missing spacing normalization for jamo/kana boundaries.

natalie: any logs/regex that reproduce?

mira: run command I used:

```
./run_eval --model nova-v1 --quant int8 --locales ko,ja,ar,he --metrics chrF,bleu --batch 256 --cache-prefix s3://redwood-evals/nova-v1/int8/2026-02-28/
```

mira: upload: s3://redwood-evals/nova-v1/int8/2026-02-28/report.csv (rows with locale, metric, seed).

sam: could this be tokenization differences between the quantized tokenizer binary? did the tokenizer get rebuilt during quant pipeline?

mira: we use the same tokenizer artifacts; quant pipeline only touches weights. but the runtime selects a different detok path for int8 kernels (fast-detok v2). suspect fast-detok regression.

ji a: @oleg do we have telemetry showing detok path used per request?

oleg: yes — console traces show int8 routes hitting detok_route=v2:fast. fp16 uses detok_route=v1:stable. I'll attach routing trace snippet.

ci-bot: [test-run] nova-v1 int8 locale smoke — failure rate 0.9% (mostly detok mismatch)

oleg: quick check: small script to compare tokenization boundaries between routes:

```
python -c "from tokenizer import Tok; a=Tok('형님께서 오셨어요.'); print(a.tokens())"
```

oleg: initial run shows token lists differ by boundary at '형님' -> ['형', '님'] vs ['형님'] on fast-detok.

mira: also found RTL example:

```
src (ar): "(تقرير) تمت المعالجة"
int8 output: ")تقرير( تمت المعالجة"
```

mira: parentheses swapped sides (closing bracket moved left) — classic bidi/directionality handling issue.

sam: escalate to runtime team? we should bisect the fast-detok change. any recent PRs?

oleg: PR 4392 landed last week — introduced a heuristic to drop zero-width joiners in prefix cache to save memory. could interact with zwnj/zwj handling.

jia: that would explain ZWJ/ZWNJ-related merges in jp/ko/ja. we saw ZWJ removal causing grapheme joins earlier.

natalie: proposal: create a targeted smoke job that runs small sample for ja/ko/ar/he on both detok v1 and v2 and diff tokens + detok outputs. Run on canary.

mira: I prepared a diff harness, pointing to s3 input. command:

```
./diff_detok --model nova-v1 --routes v1,v2 --locales ko,ja,ar,he --out s3://redwood-evals/nova-v1/int8/diffs/1758004321/
```

deploy-bot: Canary deployed nova-v1 int8 (canary-23) to eng-test (route: v2-fast) at 2026-02-28T16:12:02Z

sam: great. oleg, can you run the diff harness and post top-10 mismatches?

oleg: running now — should have results in ~15m. cc @mira @jia

(15m later)

oleg: uploaded diffs: s3://redwood-evals/nova-v1/int8/diffs/1758004321/top_mismatches.json

oleg: top mismatch examples: 1) '형님' split; 2) 'お母さん' -> 'お 母さん'; 3) arabic bracket flip; 4) hebrew directional mark dropped around quotes.

mira: thanks. this narrows down to (a) fast-detok grapheme boundary logic, (b) prefix cache ZWJ strip. both can be repro'd locally.

sam: next steps: 1) runtime roll back heuristic from PR 4392 on canary and re-run diff; 2) add unit tests for ZWJ/ZWNJ preservation for ko/ja and bidi bracket orientation tests for ar/he; 3) hold int8 onboard until green.

natalie: I'll open a jira for test coverage and mark onboard-blocker.

jia: +1 on hold. also we should add a small eval to CI that runs a handful of locale-sensitive detok samples on every runtime change.

mira: created minimal repro snippets in /mnt/shared/locales/ko_ja_ar_he_repro.txt and uploaded to the canary workspace.

oleg: rolling back PR 4392 on canary now. will report when diff run completes.

ci-bot: [ci] locale-detok-unit-tests triggered by revert-4392 — 3 tests failing (flaky)

mira: ping when CI stable. thanks all :sparkles:
